messages:
IncidentBot: :warning: HIGH: latency SLO breach detected for /v1/generate (p95=420ms, p99=1.45s) — alerting oncall. correlated increase in streaming stall counts and tail tokens.
Alyssa_SRE: seeing the alert, paging @Dmitri_Oncall now. any ETA on scope?
Dmitri_Oncall: on it, looking at dashboards. p95 jumped around 14:02 UTC, p99 spike at 14:04. Streaming stalls up 6x over baseline.
Ben_Runtime: I can see increased per-request preprocessing time. median preprocess went from 12ms -> 280ms. suspect prompt construction blowup.
Carla_ML: any recent model rollouts? or big schema changes in tool-mode?
DeployBot: deploy 2026-03-15T14:00Z -> rollout complete to prod: prompt-builder v2.9.1 (template optimizer)
Alyssa_SRE: ok that lines up. Ben, can you capture a slow example from the live tail?
Ben_Runtime: grabbing tail logs now — here's a sample (sanitized):
```
request_id=abc123 user=customer-xyz route=/v1/generate
prompt_template_id=toolchain-large-v3
tool_schema_size_bytes=423456
json_mode=true
preproc_ms=1184
tokenize_ms=210
kv_build_ms=320
```

Ben_Runtime: large tool_schema is being inlined into the prompt on every request, plus json_mode expands all tool inputs. that explains preproc spike.
Dmitri_Oncall: customer impact — is this affecting hosted customers or only Dedicated? metrics show error rate unchanged but tail latency affecting streaming clients (timeouts).
Alyssa_SRE: customer-xyz had 3 streaming timeouts in last 5m. Support ticket 12456 opened. escalate to customer success if needed.
Carla_ML: quick mitigation options: 1) revert prompt-builder rollout, 2) enable schema reference mode instead of inlining, 3) apply prefix caching and short-circuit heavy template expansion for known templates.
Ben_Runtime: I can push a runtime guard to detect tool_schema_size_bytes > 100k and switch to schema-ref mode at the router level. can do that as a hotfix.
Dmitri_Oncall: preferred minimal blast radius: runtime guard + throttle long preproc tasks. any adverse effects?
Carla_ML: schema-ref mode will slightly change context sent to model but should be backwards compatible; quality impact negligible for most customers.
Alyssa_SRE: action plan: 1) Ben deploys guard to route large schemas to ref mode and enables prefix-cache warmup; 2) rollback of prompt-builder if guard doesn't mitigate in 10m; 3) alert CS about affected customers.
Ben_Runtime: starting hotfix branch now. will deploy to canaries first (10% traffic).
Ben_Runtime: canary up @14:12 UTC — immediate p99 improvement observed: canary p99=590ms vs prod p99=1.45s.
Dmitri_Oncall: nice. rolling hotfix to 50% and enabling short TTL prefix cache for prompt templates.
Alyssa_SRE: watching global p95/p99 — p95 back to 180ms, p99 trending down to 700ms. streaming stall rate down 60%.
Carla_ML: also toggled json_mode fallback for large tool schemas — we now send a compact JSON pointer instead of full payload.
Ben_Runtime: full rollout complete @14:20 UTC. metrics: p95=160ms, p99=420ms. streaming stalls back to baseline.
Alyssa_SRE: excellent. Support: customer-xyz notified and we offered temporary quota bump or cached responses if they prefer.
Dmitri_Oncall: will keep monitoring for 30m. logging retention for this request path increased to capture further anomalies. leaving oncall to Alyssa for next 2 hours. handing off.
Alyssa_SRE: taking handoff — I'll run a follow-up RCA doc and link to this thread. immediate RCA items: why prompt-builder chose to inline large schemas, missing mitigations for json_mode, unit tests for template size, and add runtime guard as permanent.
Carla_ML: I'll add a model-eval to ensure schema-ref mode doesn't regress quality for tool-heavy prompts.
Ben_Runtime: will open a ticket to add size-based guards and add telemetry for tool_schema_size distribution.
DeployBot: incident severity auto-update -> SEV3 (service degradation mitigated)
IncidentBot: Incident closed (provisional) — monitoring window 30m. summary: prompt construction inflation (large tool schemas + json_mode inlining) caused preprocessing tail latency and streaming stalls; mitigated by runtime size-guard, schema-ref fallback, and prefix cache warmup.
Dmitri_Oncall: thanks team. I'll post a short blameless timeline and tag eng-runtime / eng-ml for the RCA.
Alyssa_SRE: good job. I'll update the incident tracker and notify CS/Support. :thumbsup:
